<!-- Purpose: Guide focused and reviewable public pull requests. -->

## Summary

Describe the change and its scope.

## Motivation and related issue

Explain the problem being solved and link a related issue where applicable.

## Affected components

List the affected commands, modules, documentation, or packaging components.

## Tests performed

List the offline tests and other checks performed. Explain any omitted checks.

## Security and ownership impact

Describe changes to trust boundaries, ownership checks, privileges, persistent state, or cleanup behavior. Write `None` if there is no impact.

## Documentation changes

List updated public documentation or explain why no update is needed.

## Known limitations

State remaining limitations or missing real-world validation.

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private keys, or sensitive host data are included.
- [ ] The change remains within the scope described above.
- [ ] Relevant tests were run, or missing checks are explained.
- [ ] No real host or VM operation was performed without explicit authorization.
